units.source_text: 源氏回紫夫人房中去了。

en.t: Genji returned to Lady Murasaki's rooms.

units.source_text: 明石夫人在背后私议道：“他对紫夫人的宠爱越来越深。

en.t: Lady Akashi said privately afterward, "His love for Lady Murasaki grows deeper and deeper.

units.source_text: 这位夫人的人品，的确十全无缺，高人一等，理应如此承宠，教人不胜赞佩。

en.t: Her character is truly flawless and far above others, so it is only natural that she should be so favored; one cannot help admiring her.

units.source_text: 他对三公主，表面上也很重视，然而在她房中留宿的日子不多，实在委屈了她。

en.t: He appears to treat the Third Princess with great importance too, but he spends few nights in her rooms, and she is truly wronged by it.

units.source_text: 她和紫夫人同一血统，而身份比紫夫人更高，因此更多痛苦了。”

en.t: She is of the same bloodline as Lady Murasaki, and her rank is even higher, so her suffering must be all the greater."

units.source_text: 她回想自己，觉得宿世福报不浅，深可庆幸。

en.t: Thinking back on her own life, she felt that her blessings from former lives were not slight, and she was deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 她想：“三公主身份如此高贵，尚且在这世间不能如意称心，何况我这对她望尘莫及的人。

en.t: She thought, "Even the Third Princess, with such noble status, cannot have everything as she wishes in this world; how much less could someone like me, who cannot begin to compare with her.

units.source_text: 我今生已无恨事，只是挂念那位断绝尘缘、闭居深山的老父，不免悲伤耳。”

en.t: I have no regrets in this life now; I only grieve when I think of my old father, who has cut himself off from worldly ties and lives secluded deep in the mountains."

units.source_text: 她的母亲师姑老太太呢，只管信赖道人信中所言“福地园莳种善因”之语，时时想念后世之事，寂寞地度送岁月。

en.t: As for her mother, the elderly nun, she simply trusted the priest's words in his letter about planting good causes in a blessed field, and she passed the days in loneliness, constantly thinking of the world to come.
